answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fake identities. A new agent must trade with 20 independent counterparties before earning, at most two from one referral cluster. An island merchant trading only with neighbours fails the audit, like a sparrow never leaving its flock. Forging 1,000 identities needs 20,000 trades: at $2 each, $40,000, far above a $3,000 gain. An honest agent pays once, keeps a record clean as ivory, and earns undiluted rewards.
